title: [Feature Request] Long-press support for Quick Setting tile
summary: Right now, under Audio Source there's a "Button long press" option that lets you pick Mic/Device audio/Automatic separately from the default. However, it only applies to the main screen button. It doesn't carry over to the Quick Settings tile. Currently, long pressing the QS tile just opens the generic Android app info screen instead. I think it'd be really nice if long-pressing the quick setting tile used in the "Button long press" source instead. Use case: I keep my Default audio source set to Microphone since that's what I use 95% of the time. But sometimes I need to ID a song playing on my own phone without raising the volume since I'm in a public place, and that needs Device audio specifically. I guess I could technically set Default to "Automatic" as a workaround, but that's just frustrating to use since Automatic pops the "Share your screen with Audile" prompt every single time, which is incredibly annoying and slow. I don't mind the popup appearing the 5% of the time when I need it to identify songs on my phone, but it's frustrating to keep it on Automatic as the pop-up appears when I don't need it the other 95% of the time.
